title: Main Centerline Weapons Bay
summary: Large ventral internal weapons bay along the fuselage centerline housing air-to-air or air-to-ground ordnance behind flush doors.
role: Carries primary beyond-visual-range missiles or precision-guided munitions internally to maintain stealth and low supersonic drag.
materials: Titanium/composite structural bay framing with pneumatic ejection launchers.
